subject: af-con
title: AF.CON.------RE.ST.
description: Diagram in WAC-27, the third on book p229. (C)AF-CON (affinity convergence) is crossed with RE-ST (restructuralism). Embedded in the Euro-American discussion: when affinity-convergence (the bringing-together of disparate affinity tendencies under one project) is crossed with restructuralism, what's the resulting structural shape? AF-CON outputs to RE-ST (the crossing) and to INFO-DY (information dynamics) → LANG-DY (language dynamics). LANG-DY branches to LG-EXT (logical extension) → POST (postulation), and to AFL-DT (affinity dictates) → IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics) → PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) → SOC-RT-INTR (social reality interpretation) → INFO-DE (information degrees).
